answer: We deploy dynamic opportunity-cost bonds and subgame-perfect slashing matrices, leveraging staking collateral and zero-knowledge verifiable delay to neutralize any gale of forged identities. Capital barrier analysis proves the expected payoff of identity multiplication is strictly negative, as the inlet of illicit sable tokens is vastly outweighed by destroyed pledges. This cryptoeconomic primitive ensures negative expected attack utility, driving adversarial multi-agent environments toward a robust Nash equilibrium.
